fusions.name: Split Decision
fusions.desc: Throws a bolt that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, then branches to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles for 60% of that damage. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Muddled] for 5 seconds, and your afflictions on the first target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Tine After Tine
fusions.desc: Two quick prongs, each of which deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Crook of the Bough
fusions.desc: You wedge yourself in place: your armour rises by 20% and your dodge chance by 10% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Tine
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 7 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 8 seconds.
